platform_constraint_evidence: Cargo.toml workspace.metadata.vendor-filter only lists Linux targets (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, i686-unknown-linux-gnu, powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu, s390x-unknown-linux-gnu, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu). CI workflows run on ubuntu-latest. Dependencies include libsystemd and systemd-journal-logger (Linux systemd specific). Socket paths use Unix domain sockets (/run/bpfman-sock). Project uses eBPF which is Linux-specific.
notes: Repository is a Rust workspace for bpfman (eBPF manager). Linux-only due to eBPF, systemd, and Unix socket dependencies. Fix adds socket directory creation and logging initialization to RPC and CLI binaries. No test.patch present - tests may need synthesis. Build requires clang, llvm, libbpf-dev, and other system deps.
